_meta.com.requstory/summary: Today's UK trade prices for café supplies: median of suppliers, changes, who sells it cheapest, world market figures; dated.

description: Today's UK trade prices for café and catering supplies (coffee beans, tea, milk, butter, eggs, sugar, flour, paper cups, lids, takeaway boxes, cleaning): the median of UK suppliers in the Requstory Index in one unit (per kg, per litre, per 1,000), its change on a day, a week, a month and a year (suppliers priced on both days only), and the world market or official figure beside it with its own date. With "commodity", also who sells it, cheapest first, each price with its source (read from the supplier's website or entered by the supplier) and the date checked. Fewer than 3 suppliers: no median. Read-only.

commodity.description: Optional: a commodity id or words, e.g. "whole-milk", "milk", "paper cups". Leave it out for every commodity.

region.description: GB (or UK). Other regions come later.

name: get_prices
title: Get today's supply prices
